name: Le cabinet ORL
camera: from the waiting-room arch, facing west into the ear-nose-throat room

setting.walls: pale primrose-yellow plaster walls above soft mint-green tiles
setting.floor: grey-green linoleum with a cream border
setting.landmark: a big gentle grey baby elephant standing in the back centre, one huge ear fanned out, plus an old reclining ENT chair with a round head-mirror lamp
setting.light: even daylight from two tall windows on the right
setting.style: S07 gentle storybook painterly 3.5/5 (one style for the whole Quartier de la Santé)

items.scene: A robot's HEAD built of bright TETRIS ("TEHT") blocks clicks neatly into place on its neck, one last block dropping in.
A friendly stingray RAY ("oh-REHY") watches from its glass tank beside a baby elephant fanning out one huge floppy EAR.
A frog on the ENT chair stretches out a LONG, LONG ("LAHNG") TONGUE to hold a pink seashell up to the smiling baby elephant.
A potted BUSH ("BOOSH") is clipped into a giant smiling MOUTH, lips and two rows of leafy teeth, saying aah.
A girl pulls a big wooden LEVER ("LEHVR") on a puppet stand, and the puppet's red LIPS lift into a huge smile.
A pony NEIGHS ("NAY") so hard through its big NOSE that the doctor's paper hat blows off.
A wooden CUCKOO ("KOO") springs out of its clock on an extra-long stretchy NECK and coos at the patients.
A boy FROWNS ("FROHN") so hard that his whole FOREHEAD wrinkles, and a ladybird slides down the creases.

prompt:
Gentle storybook painterly illustration, realism about 3.5/5, soft gouache-and-oil brushwork, warm-hearted and calm, natural NEUTRAL daylight with true colours, off-white whites, no orange, sepia, amber or golden cast, no pink or blue tint, clear readable figures with contact shadows on the floor, consistent eye-level perspective, 16:9 wide composition.
Scene: Le cabinet ORL in the B17_cabinet building, ground floor (west). Camera: from the waiting-room arch, facing west into the ear-nose-throat room.
Setting: pale primrose-yellow plaster walls above soft mint-green tiles; floor: grey-green linoleum with a cream border. Landmark: a giant two-metre plaster model of a smiling HEAD standing in the back centre, plus an old reclining ENT chair with a round head-mirror lamp. Light: even daylight from two tall windows on the right. The room feels lived-in and real, with depth (never an empty white backdrop).
Paint these exits clearly as walkable openings: the arch edge and parquet threshold in the near left foreground (way to La salle d'attente); an open archway on the LEFT (south) wall glowing with lavender-grey wallpaper and mirror bulbs (way to Le miroir); a glazed double door on the RIGHT (north) wall showing wall bars (way to La salle de gym).
Characters and objects, each a separate, clearly spaced group, feminine-word groups on the left half and masculine-word groups on the right half:
- left, middle distance: A robot's HEAD built of bright TETRIS blocks clicks neatly into place on its neck, one last block dropping in.
- left, foreground: A friendly stingray RAY swims up in a glass tank and holds a big seashell to the giant plaster model's EAR.
- centre-left, middle distance: A frog on the ENT chair shoots out a LONG, LONG TONGUE and snatches a fly from the doctor's torch beam.
- centre-left, foreground: A potted BUSH is clipped into a giant smiling MOUTH, lips and two rows of leafy teeth, saying aah.
- centre-right, middle distance: A girl pulls a big wooden LEVER on a puppet stand, and the puppet's red LIPS lift into a huge smile.
- centre-right, foreground: A pony NEIGHS so hard through its big NOSE that the doctor's paper hat blows off.
- right, middle distance: A wooden CUCKOO springs out of its clock on an extra-long stretchy NECK and coos at the patients.
- right, foreground: A boy FROWNS so hard that his whole FOREHEAD wrinkles, and a ladybird slides down the creases.
Leave a blank light board for the room sign high on the back wall. No written words, letters, numbers or logos anywhere (signs and plaques are blank boards). No blood, no wounds, no needles in skin (syringes only as capped harmless props), no alcohol, no smoking, no religious symbols, no red-cross emblem. Nobody cropped by the image edge; keep every figure well inside the frame with a clear gap between figures. Figures stand on the floor or sit on real furniture, never floating or in rows behind a counter.
